products.product_description: Crunch Pak Apple Slices with Low Fat Caramel Dip, 5/2.5 oz. Tart with Caramel Sauce. The clamshell includes 5/2 oz. bags of sliced apples and 5/ 0.5 oz. packages of caramel (sauce) dip. The UPC on the clamshell is 7 32313 09113 9. The clamshell package is labeled in parts: "***CRUNCH PAK***TART***apple Slices***WITH LOW FAT CARAMEL DIP***5-2 oz BAGS***5-0.5 oz CARAMEL DIP***NET WT. 12.5 oz***Crunch Pak, LLC Cashmere, WA 98815***".
products.reason_for_recall: Crunch Pak Apple Slices are recalled due to a potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes.
